scope: one fresh hidden-value task; deny under version 2, explicitly authorize exact whole replacement under version 3 with a new observation identity, then execute and independently verify
promotion_scope: task-scoped whole replacement may cross a redacted target only with exact current observation/policy/text authority; stale replay remains refused
limits: one task and one model decision per policy state; local raw source retained; no append/selection variants, privacy deployment, latency population or general capability claim
